_doc: v0.9.18 Movesets commentary (docs/audio/COMMENTARY.md); recordings in docs/audio/breeze/v0.9.18.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And here comes the stream! Hold the button, hold the line!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They're pouring it on now! Steer it, keep it on them!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A sustained attack. My favourite kind. It lasts as long as my attention.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught in the stream! There's no getting out of that by standing still!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's soaking right through the guard! Move, move, move!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: All that pressure, and it painted the floor. Lovely floor.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Shot away! Lined up and let go!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the projectile! Sidestep or swallow it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Right on target! Thread the needle and it lands clean!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Oh, that found them. From that far? Rude.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Wide! That shot sails past and keeps on going!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A spread of shots! Something in there is going to land!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: One shot is a statement. Several shots is a strategy.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The volley connects! Count them later, they all hurt now!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That was a lot of shots for no hits. Statistically impressive.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Charging it up! You can feel the pressure building from here!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the big one! Let it rip!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: BOOM! Full blast, full force, full marks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That blast sends them flying! What a release!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: All that charge, and it hits nothing! Now they're wide open!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A huge blast at nothing. Very dramatic for an empty corner.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And they're off like a shot! Straight at them!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Full speed ahead! That's a rush with bad intentions!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Run through! Didn't stop, didn't slow down, didn't apologise!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Overcommitted! They rushed right past and the door is open!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They're waiting for it! Swing now and you're walking into the counter!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A counter stance. The polite way of saying "go on, try it".

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Counter! Read it, caught it, sent it right back!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Owning the floor! That space belongs to one fighter now!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Area control. Like owning real estate, but it hurts to visit.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught in the zone! Get out of there before it gets worse!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A smart reset there, buying a little advantage for the next exchange.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A support move. Somebody's playing the long game tonight.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Repositioning! That fighter is going somewhere better!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Not an attack, exactly. More of a relocation with menace.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke opens the stovepipe! It's a flamethrower, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Fire from the furnace! Stoke's sweeping the cage with flame!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Oh, he just breathes fire now. That's new. That's very new.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Still pouring it on! That flame is following them around!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught in the flamethrower! That's Sizzle stacking up fast!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That's not a tan. That's the flamethrower.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Up and over goes a hot coal! Where it lands, it burns!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He threw a piece of his own furnace. That seems like a heating problem.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke scoops a coal and lobs it! Look out below!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Right on top of them! The coal bursts and the ground starts burning!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The cinder lands on target! And the floor's on fire now too!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes Stoke, all four stacks blazing behind him!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He just left at speed. I felt that from here.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The stacks fire and Stoke launches! Flare Rush!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Boom! The punch explodes and sends both of them flying apart!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Flare Rush connects and it EXPLODES! Both of them go flying!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A ring of flame around the furnace! Step inside at your own risk!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke spins up a ring of fire! Nobody's getting close now!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Burned on the way in! The fire ring does its job!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He is blowing bubbles at a professional fighter. And it is working.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge blows a stream of bubbles! Pretty, soggy and right in the way!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Bubbles. In a cage fight. I'm charmed and a little worried.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The bubbles pop on contact! Stay in that and you will be soaked through!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The claw is filling up! That cannon is going to go off any second!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge braces and charges the hydro cannon! Get out of the line!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hydro Cannon! The whole harbour in one shot!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Blasted clean across the cage! That's the hydro cannon, folks!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: And the recoil sent Dredge back too. Everyone's moving tonight.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A whirlpool opens up! It's pulling everything toward the middle!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Swimming lessons, now included with the ticket price.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dragged into the whirlpool! Swim against it or go under!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge tucks into his shell. Hits land soft and barely move him now.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A flick of the wing and the wind cuts straight down the line!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He cut the air in half. The air did not see it coming.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Air Slash! A crescent of wind cutting straight across!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Sliced from range! That crescent went straight through!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Air Slash slices right through! Precision from range!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Feathers in a fan! Five of them, all heading the same way!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A fan of feather darts! Gusto's filling the air!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Those are real feathers. I hope he grows them back.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The feathers stick! That's a few too many darts to dodge!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto whips up a twister! It's travelling and it's hungry!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Swept up in the twister! Around and around and out!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tailwind! Gusto's quicker than ever for the next few seconds.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer splits the floor! Rocks are coming up in a line!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He is redecorating. Mostly with rocks.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Rock Slide! The floor tears open in a straight line!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught by the rock slide! And those rocks are staying put!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He dug that boulder up with his face. I have so many questions.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer heaves a boulder! That's a lot of rock in the air!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The boulder lands on them! Flattened!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Quake Stomp! The whole cage jumps!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Down they go! You cannot stand on a floor that is jumping!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tripped by the quake! Feet off the floor, rear on the floor!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Iron Hide. Little shots are going to bounce right off Dozer now.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Spit, spit, spit! Three darts on the way!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Poison darts! Three quick shots, all of them nasty!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The darts stick! That poison is going to work for a while!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Darts. Venom darts. I'd like to see the inside of that mouth less.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The acid is pouring! Stand in that and the guard melts away!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry sprays acid! Wide, wet and wicked!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Doused in acid! That Gunk is piling on!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry wraps up and squeezes! There's no guard against a coil!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That is a hug. A very bad hug.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Coil Crush! Squeezed and slammed!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry sheds the skin and everything stuck to it. Clean start.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Thunder Jolt! That bolt is quicker than your eyes!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The bolt lands before they can even flinch! That jolt is building fast!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Discharge! Lightning in every direction!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught in the discharge! Anyone too close just got zapped!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Chain Lightning! Watch it jump!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Chain Lightning connects! And it is looking for someone else to bite!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Wet fighters conduct. I'm writing that down for safety reasons.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A static field crackles to life! Step in there and you'll flinch!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A cold beam from the porthole! Everything it touches slows to a crawl!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The helmet light becomes a beam! Night Shade, and it is cold!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught in the ghostly beam! Haunted, and slowing down!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The chain flies out of the dark! Anything it catches comes back with it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A spectral chain! Knell's reeling somebody in!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Chained! Slowed and dragged right back to the diver!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Three tiny lanterns. Adorable. Terrifying. Mostly terrifying.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Lantern Swarm! Three little lights, all of them hunting!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The wisps find their mark! You can't outrun a ghost light!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He rings the helmet like a bell! Careful, swinging into that answers back!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The bell tolls! Hit Knell now and you'll hear it twice!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Comet Hook! The gold arc keeps travelling and clips whoever's next!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The hook lands and the shockwave trails right behind it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Spiral Hook! The aura spins them around and drags them back in!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He punched them into a spin. I didn't know punches could do laps.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Pressure Palm! The aura leaves his hand and flies across the cage!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Force Palm, point blank! That guard simply stopped existing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Meteor Hammer! The floor cracks right under that overhead!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Thunder Chop! Quick over the top, and the spark freezes them!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The kick throws a shockwave! He's hitting from outside his own reach!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: His kicks travel further than his legs do. Physics has filed a complaint.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Iron Shins! He kicks straight through whatever's coming at him!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Shins of iron. That explains why he walks so loudly.
